header.running_head: 2. The Effects of the Qur'an and Hadith...

blocks.tamil_translation: you will see (O Prophet) their eyes shedding tears!

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَإِذَا قُرِأَ الْقُرْآنُ فَاسْتَمِعُوا لَهُ وَأَنْصِتُوا لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: And when the Qur'an is recited, listen to it attentively and remain silent, so that you may be shown mercy.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (قَالَ فَإِنِ اتَّبَعْتَنِي فَلَا تَسْئَلْنِي عَنْ شَيْءٍ حَتَّي أُحْدِثَ لَكَ مِنْهُ ذِكْرًا۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: He said, “If you follow me, then do not ask me about anything (at all) until I myself tell you about it.”

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (فَبَشِّرْ عِبَادِ۞ الَّذِينَ يَسْتَمِعُونَ الْقَوْلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحْسَنَهُ ؕ أُولئِكَ الَّذِينَ هَدَاهُمُ اللهُ وَأُولئِكَ هُمْ أُولُوا اْلاَلْبَابِ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: (O Prophet,) give glad tidings to My (righteous) servants - those who listen attentively to the word (of Allah) and then follow the best of it; they are the ones whom Allah has guided, and they are the people of (clear) understanding.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (اَللهُ نَزَّلَ أَحْسَنَ الْحَدِيثِ كِتَاباً مُّتَشَابِهاً مَّثَانِيَ تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُودُ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ ۚ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمْ وَقُلُوبُهُمْ إِلَي ذِكْرِ اللهِ ؕ ).
blocks.tamil_translation: Allah has sent down the most beautiful message - a Book consistent with itself, recited over and over again; the skins (and the hair on the skins) of those who fear their Rabb shiver from it; then
